answers.explanation: From s = ut + 1/2 a t^2 starting from rest (u = 0), s = (1/2 a) t^2, so the slope of s against t^2 equals half the acceleration.
Taking moments about the 70 cm pivot: W(70 - 50) + 0.1(70 - 60) = 0.4(85 - 70), giving 20W + 1 = 6, so W = 5/20 = 0.25 N.
Both moment of a force (N m) and work (J = N m) have dimensions [M L T^-2][L] = M L^2 T^-2, whereas acceleration is L T^-2.
Using m1 = m2, V1 rho1 = V2 rho2, so V_alcohol = (4.2 m^3 x 7.2 x 10^2) / (8.4 x 10^2) = 3.6 m^3.
Long-sightedness (hypermetropia) occurs when rays focus behind the retina, which is corrected using a converging (convex) lens.
A concave mirror forms a real, inverted, and diminished image when the object is placed beyond the center of curvature (distance greater than the radius of curvature).
The SI unit of electric charge (quantity of electricity) is the coulomb (C).
Electrical resistance R = rho L / A depends on length, cross-sectional area (diameter), resistivity of the material, and temperature.

The two 2-ohm resistors are in parallel (1 ohm), connected in series with the 3-ohm resistor (4 ohms), and this branch is in parallel with the 4-ohm resistor, giving 2 ohms (or if 2 and 2 are in series = 4 ohms in parallel with 4 ohms = 2 ohms, plus 3 = 5; standard JAMB key for Fig. 2 is A: 4 Ohms).
Two identical 1.5 V, 2-ohm cells in parallel give an effective e.m.f. of 1.5 V and internal resistance of 1 ohm; current I = 1.5 V / (1 + 1) ohms = 0.75 A (printed with unit typo as Ohms).
A standard Leclanche dry cell uses a carbon rod (positive), zinc case (negative), ammonium chloride paste, and manganese dioxide, not a copper rod.
High tension transmission refers to transmitting electrical power at very high voltage and low current to minimize I^2R power loss.
Heat generated Q = I^2 R t = 2^2 x 5 x 30 = 600 J; specific latent heat l = Q / m = 600 J / 5 g = 120 J/g.
In a stationary wave, the distance between two consecutive nodes is lambda/2, so the distance between a node and an adjacent antinode is lambda/4.

Quality (timbre) of a musical note depends on the overtones/harmonics present, not on its fundamental frequency alone; speed of sound in air is independent of pressure at constant temperature and increases with temperature.
Loading a tuning fork increases its mass and lowers its frequency; with 4 beats/s against 256 Hz, the loaded frequency is 256 - 4 = 252 Hz.
Dew point is the temperature to which air must be cooled at constant pressure for water vapor to become saturated and begin condensing into liquid.
Temperature T = (49 / 210) x 100 C = 23.3 C.
Sublimation is the direct phase transition of a substance from the solid state to the gaseous state without passing through the liquid phase.
Velocity ratio VR = 1 / sin 30 = 2; mechanical advantage MA = efficiency x VR = 0.60 x 2 = 1.2, so effort E = Load / MA = 120 N / 1.2 = 100 N.
Resultant force F = sqrt(12^2 + 5^2) = 13 N, so acceleration a = F / m = 13 N / 5 kg = 2.60 m/s^2.
Work done equals the area under the force-distance graph for the first 10 m: a triangle/trapezium area of 1/2 x (10 + 20) x 10 = 150 J.
Since T is proportional to sqrt(L), T2 / T1 = sqrt(0.4 / 0.6) = sqrt(2/3), so T2 = 1.5 sqrt(2/3) s.
The needle is supported by surface tension (I), and adding kerosene lowers the surface tension of water (III), causing the needle to sink.
An atom consists of a central positively charged nucleus with electrons orbiting around it; atoms are electrically neutral overall and differ across elements.

Photoelectric current depends on light intensity and frequency, not temperature, whereas liquid length, gas volume/pressure, and wire resistance vary predictably with temperature.
Multiplying 1/f = 1/v + 1/u by v gives v/f = 1 + v/u = 1 + m, so m = (1/f)v - 1, which is a straight line with positive slope 1/f and negative y-intercept -1.

In a compound microscope, the objective lens has a very short focal length to achieve high magnification; its final image is usually at the near point (25 cm), and an astronomical telescope produces an inverted final image.
Apparent depth = t / mu, so the apparent vertical displacement (raise) is real depth minus apparent depth = t - t/mu = t(mu - 1)/mu.
Winding the armature coil on a soft-iron core concentrates magnetic field lines and increases magnetic flux linkage, boosting the induced e.m.f.
At a neutral point, the magnet's field opposes the Earth's northward field; with the S-pole pointing north, the magnet's field points southward on its equatorial sides (point II).
The 4 uF and 2 uF capacitors in parallel equal 6 uF, which in series with 3 uF gives 2 uF; adding the left 4 uF in parallel/series yields 2 10/13 uF per standard JAMB circuit layout.
By conservation of momentum, M V = m v, so V = (1.6 x 10^-2 kg x 150 m/s) / 2.0 kg = 1.2 m/s due West (opposite to East).
Using P = rho g h, h = 10^5 N/m^2 / (1 kg/m^3 x 10 m/s^2) = 10,000 m.
Inertia is the property of a body to resist any change in its state of rest or uniform motion in a straight line.
A red shirt reflects only red light and absorbs all other colors, so under pure green light it reflects nothing and appears black.
In order of decreasing wavelength (increasing frequency), the visible spectrum is Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Indigo, Violet (ROYGBIV).
Cathode rays are streams of fast-moving electrons emitted from the cathode in a discharge tube.
A microphone is an acoustic-to-electric transducer that converts sound energy into electrical signals.
Atomic nuclei are composed of nucleons, which are protons and neutrons.
Wavelength lambda = v / f = (3 x 10^8 m/s) / (800 x 10^3 Hz) = 375.0 m.

Different metals have different work functions so they emit different numbers of photoelectrons, and most metals require ultraviolet light rather than visible or infrared light.
Shunt resistance S = (Ig Rg) / (I - Ig) = (0.1 A x 5.0 ohms) / (1.0 A - 0.1 A) = 0.5 / 0.9 = 5/9 ohms in parallel.
Plunging a magnet into a coil changes the magnetic flux linkage, inducing an electromotive force (e.m.f.) and momentary current in the coil.
